title: A thumb on the reply that delivered a result is the person's verdict
request: The owner: continue; the Home session handed over the thumbs piece so dashboards and briefs get a person's verdict too.
spec: PHASE12_TRAINING_DATA_PLAN.md 36.2: reporting and business had no keep of their own; the existing thumbs on Home's replies are read into the track outcome.
plan: Find how the feedback page can reach Home's drafts
Read a thumb on a result's reply into the outcome

decisions.decision: Only a thumb on the reply that delivered a result counts
decisions.why: a thumb on a question or a note says nothing about the dashboard or the brief

decisions.decision: Only someone who may change or review the work
decisions.why: a viewer's reaction is not the verdict of the person the help was for

decisions.decision: Wrong is a correction, not a thumb
decisions.why: it already has its own meaning on decisions

decisions.decision: Reach Home through the request's draft service
decisions.why: the page never builds its own agent; the same store and ledger as the routes

change: dclab_rnd/agentic/pages/ledger.py (the feedback handler reads a thumb on a result's reply), dclab_rnd/store/coverage.py (reporting and business no longer list a gap), tests/test_home_track_outcome.py.

findings.defect: The thumb test wrote no label at first
findings.scenario: inside a request the ledger is the request's own, and the test's stand-in services had none
findings.cause: the stand-in, not the code: the product's services always carry the workspace ledger
findings.fix: the test's stand-in services carry the test ledger

outcome: A thumb up or down on the reply that delivered an answer, a dashboard, a brief or a prepared table is now the person's verdict, so every track that is not a prediction (but advice) can record one.
lessons: A reaction counts only on the thing it judges and only from the person the help was for.
Inside a request, shared services decide which ledger is written: test with the same shape.
risks: One verdict per conversation: a thumb on an older result changes the conversation's verdict.
Advice still has no product to judge.
